videos.title: Poker
videos.overview: Gavin gets engrossed in online poker game. That's when his ex-wife shows up telling him he has to take their son for a haircut for his interview at the school they hope to get him in. But Gavin had already agreed to do it tomorrow and is doing so well at the game, he lets Skylar take him. But when they come back, the style he chose is not exactly what they hoped he would get.
